a260901p1.summary: Amid a backlash, Gov. Josh Shapiro is pumping the brakes on enormous data centers.
a260901p1.title: As Gov. Josh Shapiro, once a data center champion, calls them "predatory" and imposes guardrails, some in struggling western Pennsylvania welcome the projects (New York Times)

a260901p10.summary: Big technology and management changes are greeting John Ternus, whose long-serving predecessor, Tim Cook, will stay on as executive chair.
a260901p10.title: John Ternus takes over as Apple CEO, as Tim Cook becomes executive chair; sources say Laura Legros, an Apple hardware VP who retired in 2022, has rejoined Apple (Kalley Huang/New York Times)

a260901p11.summary: Dyson Ltd. introduced a $499 toothbrush that uses artificial intelligence and a built-in camera to give real-time feedback …
a260901p11.title: Dyson unveils the $499 CameraJet, an AI-powered toothbrush with a 100K-pixel macro lens that scans at 28 images per second and is trained on nearly 470K images (Samantha Kelly/Bloomberg)

a260901p12.summary: Expectations for Tim Cook were almost impossibly high when he stepped in to replace Apple's visionary co-founder in 2011.
a260901p12.title: A look back at Tim Cook's 15-year tenure: Apple silicon, wearables, a $1T market cap, privacy, Apple Vision Pro, Apple Car, AI, App Store battles, and Trump (Emma Roth/The Verge)

a260901p15.summary: Roku Inc. introduced its first self-branded smart TVs with organic light emitting diode, or OLED, display technology …
a260901p15.title: Roku unveils its first self-branded OLED smart TVs starting at $999, in 55" and 65" 120Hz models, and $1,299 for a 144Hz model, sold exclusively via Amazon (Chris Welch/Bloomberg)

a260901p16.summary: Mozilla is using Apple's WebKit Content Blocker technology and the EasyList filter to block ads in Firefox.
a260901p16.title: Mozilla launches built-in ad blocking for Firefox on iOS, using Apple's WebKit Content Blocker and the EasyList filter to block third-party ads and trackers (Tom Warren/The Verge)

a260901p17.summary: Savvy Games Group Chief Executive Officer Brian Ward, who oversaw the Saudi Arabian government's $38 billion investment in the video-game industry …
a260901p17.title: Memo: Savvy Games Group CEO Brian Ward, who oversaw the Saudi Arabian government's $38B investment in the video game industry since 2021, is stepping down (Cecilia D'Anastasio/Bloomberg)

a260901p18.summary: Unacademy, once one of India's most valuable edtech startups, has been acquired by rival upGrad at a valuation of just over $200 million …
a260901p18.title: Indian edtech startup upGrad closes its acquisition of rival Unacademy in an all-stock deal valuing Unacademy at ~$206M, down from its peak $3.5B valuation (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)

a260901p19.summary: Alphabet's Waymo is expanding its commercial service, and Amazon's Zoox said it plans to test in more U.S. cities, as the nascent robotaxi market gains momentum.
a260901p19.title: Waymo starts offering driverless rides to customers in San Diego, Tampa, Florida, and Denver; Amazon's Zoox says it will start testing in Houston and San Diego (Lora Kolodny/CNBC)

a260901p2.summary: OpenAI denied Apple's allegations of trade secret theft on Monday, saying the iPhone maker failed to show …
a260901p2.title: Filing: OpenAI denies Apple's allegations of trade secret theft, saying "this dispute is a mess of Apple's own making, and it is trying to blame everyone else" (Deepa Seetharaman/Reuters)

a260901p20.summary: AI is best known for transforming coding. Now, one startup is making the case for physics.
a260901p20.title: PSI, which aims to use AI "to industrialize the discovery of new physics" including cracking interstellar travel, emerges from stealth with a $58M seed (Sabrina Ortiz/The Deep View)

a260901p21.summary: As the company opens its platform to AI assistants, Chief Executive Officer Tom Conrad wants to reposition Sonos as something bigger than a speaker brand.
a260901p21.title: Sonos opens its platform to third-party AI assistants, upgrades Sonos 27voice assistant with an in-house LLM, and plans to let users create their own AI agents (Chris Welch/Bloomberg)

a260901p22.summary: And local processing could keep costs down too. — Back in February, debuted Perplexity Computer. Like Claude Cowork …
a260901p22.title: Perplexity launches Hybrid Compute, which splits workloads between frontier cloud models like Opus 5 and local LLMs, for all users of its Mac app (Igor Bonifacic/Engadget)

a260901p23.summary: Action camera maker GoPro (GPRO.O) said on Tuesday it is being acquired by Starman Optical in an all-cash deal valued at $285 million.
a260901p23.title: Starman Optical agrees to acquire GoPro in an all-cash deal valued at $285M, a premium of 29.5% to GPRO's last close; GoPro hit a market cap of $4B in 2014 (Prathik Jayaprakash/Reuters)

a260901p24.summary: Private equity firm Epiris has agreed to buy Gamma Communications Plc for about £1 billion ($1.4 billion) …
a260901p24.title: Private equity firm Epiris agrees to acquire European enterprise comms provider Gamma Communications for ~£1B, a 53% premium to Gamma's share price on April 7 (Shona Ghosh/Bloomberg)

a260901p25.summary: The Israeli startup is taking aim at the cost and complexity of observability by putting autonomous agents directly inside production environments.
a260901p25.title: DataAgent, which is developing AI agents that autonomously fix failures inside companies' own cloud infrastructure, emerges from stealth with a $10M pre-seed (CTech)

a260901p26.summary: Twenty-one firms, including several megabanks, plan to establish a company that would help guard against competition from digital assets
a260901p26.title: A consortium of 21 banks, including Bank of America, Citigroup, and Goldman Sachs, says it will establish a company and launch its stablecoin venture in H1 2027 (Gina Heeb/Wall Street Journal)

a260901p27.summary: The Israeli startup emerged from stealth with research showing thousands of AI add-ons rely on untrusted sources …
a260901p27.title: Air Security, which builds a security service for extensions and other tools installed on AI agents, emerges from stealth with $50M led by Sequoia and Greenoaks (Meir Orbach/CTech)

a260901p28.summary: This new image generation and editing app is bringing graphic design to Google Workspace.﻿
a260901p28.title: Google launches Google Pics, a creative design suite powered by Gemini and Nano Banana to compete with Canva and Adobe Express, available as a Workspace app (Jess Weatherbed/The Verge)

a260901p29.summary: SB Energy, the artificial intelligence power infrastructure company backed by Softbank, OpenAI and Nvidia …
a260901p29.title: AI power infrastructure company SB Energy, which is backed by SoftBank, OpenAI, and Nvidia, files for an IPO, and says it is "substantially dependent" on OpenAI (CJ Haddad/CNBC)

a260901p3.summary: Coalition seeks government support to crack down on pirated content and restore lost revenue
a260901p3.title: Study: ~33% of UK adults say they used illegal streaming services in the past three months, costing the sports, TV, and film industries ~£1.4B in annual revenue (Daniel Thomas/Financial Times)

a260901p4.summary: Chinese AI firm Z.ai's revenue in the first half jumped nearly fivefold from a year earlier to 954 million yuan …
a260901p4.title: Hong Kong-listed Z.ai reports H1 2026 revenue up 5x YoY to ~$142M, with "open platform and API revenue" up 28x to ~$122M, and net loss down 12% YoY to ~$308M (Juro Osawa/The Information)

a260901p5.summary: Snow day? Microsoft on Monday confirmed a widespread, multi-hour outage affecting Outlook users, leading to email delays and failures, authentication issues, and other problems.
a260901p5.title: Microsoft says it is testing a fix to an outage affecting Exchange Online and Outlook, lasting for 17+ hours from around 11:30AM ET on Monday (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)

a260901p6.summary: Google has quietly raised the price of the Google TV Streamer to $149.99.
a260901p6.title: Google raises the price of its Google TV Streamer by $50 to $150 in the US, as well as for "select" Nest cameras and doorbells, citing "rising component costs" (Abner Li/9to5Google)

a260901p7.summary: 1k — I promised Greg Chism I wouldn't reveal anything about where he lives because there are people out there obsessed with him, convinced he's a monster.
a260901p7.title: How lawn care YouTuber Greg Chism scaled a family channel to 13B views with YouTube's coaching, before YouTube banned it in 2017 following online backlash (Jon Ronson/New York Times)

a260901p8.summary: Apple Inc.'s Tim Cook handed over the reins to John Ternus on Tuesday, capping a tenure as chief executive officer that cemented …
a260901p8.title: Tim Cook took Apple's market cap from under $350B in 2011 to $4.6T today, a 2,736% total return, and annual revenue from $157B in FY 2012 to ~$477B in FY 2026 (Ryan Vlastelica/Bloomberg)

a260901p9.summary: Shares of Chinese online fashion giant Shein ended flat on its first day of trading on the Hong Kong stock exchange …
a260901p9.title: Shein ends flat at ~$6.20 per share on its first day of trading on the Hong Kong stock exchange, giving it a $26B market cap after raising $1.7B in its IPO (Jing Yang/The Information)
